      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\release-package\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 157
          },

            "line": 189
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "このセクションでは、[@zapabob](https://github.com/zapabob)が元の[OpenAI/codex](https://github.com/openai/codex)プロジェクトに追加した独自機能と拡張を紹介します。",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🤖 Sub-Agent System / サブエージェントシステム",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "**Status / 実装状況**: ✅ **Implemented / 実装済み** (v2.2.0)",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "**English**: A powerful multi-agent orchestration system that enables parallel execution of specialized AI agents. Supports 8+ predefined agents (code-reviewer, test-gen, sec-audit, deep-researcher) and custom YAML-defined agents. Achieves 2.6x speedup through parallel execution.",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "text": "**日本語**: 専門AIエージェントの並列実行を可能にする強力なマルチエージェントオーケストレーションシステム。8種類以上の定義済みエージェント（code-reviewer、test-gen、sec-audit、deep-researcher）とカスタムYAML定義エージェントをサポート。並列実行により2.6倍の高速化を実現。",
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "**Implementation / 実装**:",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Location / 場所**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/&#96; - AgentRuntime, AgentLoader, PermissionChecker",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Agent Definitions / エージェント定義**: &#96;.codex/agents/*.yaml&#96; - YAML-driven configuration",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Parallel Execution / 並列実行**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/async_subagent_integration.rs&#96; - AsyncSubAgentIntegration",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Token Budget / トークン予算**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/token_budget.rs&#96; - Per-agent limits",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "**Features / 機能**:",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "- Parallel execution / 並列実行: 2.6x faster / 2.6倍高速化",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "- Custom agent creation / カスタムエージェント作成: YAML-driven / YAML駆動",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "- Conflict resolution / コンフリクト解決: 3 merge strategies / 3種類のマージ戦略",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "- Collaboration store / コラボレーションストア: Agent communication / エージェント間通信",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "**Usage / 使用方法**:",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "# Single agent / 単一エージェント",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate code-reviewer --scope ./src",
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "text": "# Parallel agents / 並列エージェント",
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel code-reviewer,test-gen --scopes ./src,./tests",
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {

          }

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\release-package\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 157
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 189
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "このセクションでは、[@zapabob](https://github.com/zapabob)が元の[OpenAI/codex](https://github.com/openai/codex)プロジェクトに追加した独自機能と拡張を紹介します。",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🤖 Sub-Agent System / サブエージェントシステム",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "**Status / 実装状況**: ✅ **Implemented / 実装済み** (v2.2.0)",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "**English**: A powerful multi-agent orchestration system that enables parallel execution of specialized AI agents. Supports 8+ predefined agents (code-reviewer, test-gen, sec-audit, deep-researcher) and custom YAML-defined agents. Achieves 2.6x speedup through parallel execution.",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "text": "**日本語**: 専門AIエージェントの並列実行を可能にする強力なマルチエージェントオーケストレーションシステム。8種類以上の定義済みエージェント（code-reviewer、test-gen、sec-audit、deep-researcher）とカスタムYAML定義エージェントをサポート。並列実行により2.6倍の高速化を実現。",
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "**Implementation / 実装**:",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Location / 場所**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/&#96; - AgentRuntime, AgentLoader, PermissionChecker",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Agent Definitions / エージェント定義**: &#96;.codex/agents/*.yaml&#96; - YAML-driven configuration",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Parallel Execution / 並列実行**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/async_subagent_integration.rs&#96; - AsyncSubAgentIntegration",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Token Budget / トークン予算**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/token_budget.rs&#96; - Per-agent limits",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "**Features / 機能**:",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "- Parallel execution / 並列実行: 2.6x faster / 2.6倍高速化",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "- Custom agent creation / カスタムエージェント作成: YAML-driven / YAML駆動",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "- Conflict resolution / コンフリクト解決: 3 merge strategies / 3種類のマージ戦略",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "- Collaboration store / コラボレーションストア: Agent communication / エージェント間通信",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "**Usage / 使用方法**:",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "# Single agent / 単一エージェント",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate code-reviewer --scope ./src",
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "text": "# Parallel agents / 並列エージェント",
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel code-reviewer,test-gen --scopes ./src,./tests",
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 188
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.44181111454963684
    },

            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Execution mode (single, orchestrated, competition)",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "        #[clap(long, default_value = \"orchestrated\", value_parser = parse_execution_mode)]",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "        mode: ExecutionMode,",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Token budget",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "        #[clap(long, default_value = \"100000\")]",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "        budget_tokens: u64,",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Time budget in minutes",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "        #[clap(long, default_value = \"30\")]",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "        budget_time: u64,",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// List all Plans",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "    List {",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Filter by state (drafting, pending, approved, rejected)",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "        #[clap(long)]",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "        state: Option&lt;String&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Approve a Plan",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "    Approve {",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Plan ID",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "        plan_id: String,",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Reject a Plan",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    Reject {",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Plan ID",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "        plan_id: String,",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Rejection reason",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "        #[clap(long)]",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "        reason: String,",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Export a Plan",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "    Export {",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Plan ID",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "        plan_id: String,",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Export format (md, json, both)",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "        #[clap(long, default_value = \"both\")]",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "        format: String,",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Export path",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "        #[clap(long, default_value = \"docs/Plans\")]",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "        path: PathBuf,",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Get Plan status",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "    Status {",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Plan ID",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "        plan_id: String,",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",

          }
        ]

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\plan\\execution-modes.md",
        "range": {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Execution Modes - Detailed Guide",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Version**: 0.57.0",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "plan mode supports 3 execution strategies, each optimized for different use cases.",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "| Mode | Use Case | Speed | Quality | Complexity |",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "|------|----------|-------|---------|------------|",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "| **Single** | Simple edits | ⚡⚡⚡ | ⭐⭐ | Low |",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "| **Orchestrated** | Complex features | ⚡⚡ | ⭐⭐⭐ | Medium |",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "| **Competition** | Optimization | ⚡ | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | High |",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## Single Mode",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "### When to Use",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Single-file changes",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Typo fixes, docstring additions",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Simple refactoring (rename variable)",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Quick iterations",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "### Architecture",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "Plan (approved)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "Single LLM Agent",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "File edits + tests",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "Done",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "### Example",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "**Task**: Add docstring to a function",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add docstring to calculate_total()\" --mode=single",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "**Execution**:",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Single agent reads function",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Generates docstring",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Applies patch",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Runs linter",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "5. Done in ~30 seconds",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "## Orchestrated Mode (Default)",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### When to Use",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Multi-file features",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Full-stack changes (backend + frontend)",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Database migrations",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Security-sensitive code",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Test generation required",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "### Architecture",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "Plan (approved)",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "Central Planner",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "    ├── Task DAG",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "    └── Sub-Agent Assignments",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "        ↓",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "Parallel Execution",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Backend Agent    → API changes",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Frontend Agent   → UI updates",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Database Agent   → Schema migrations",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Security Agent   → Vulnerability review",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "└─ QA Agent         → Test generation",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "Integrator",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Collect patches",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Run linters/tests",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "└─ Prepare PR",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "Done",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "### Example",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "**Task**: Migrate session auth to JWT",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Refactor auth to JWT\" --mode=orchestrated",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "**Execution Flow**:",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Planner** analyzes Plan",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Identifies 5 work items (JWT service, DB migration, API endpoints, frontend client, tests)",
            "lineNumber": 102
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.45005375146865845
    },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\plan\\manager.rs",
        "range": {

          "endPosition": {

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! Plan manager",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! High-level API for creating, updating, approving, and exporting plan.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ## Integration with Official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This custom Plan module works in conjunction with the official Plan Mode collaboration",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! template (&#96;codex-rs/core/templates/collaboration_mode/plan.md&#96;). The official template",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! provides the conversational prompt structure for LLM interactions, while this module",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! manages the structured &#96;PlanBlock&#96; data that results from those interactions.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Official Plan Mode Improvements (commits #9877, #9874)",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The official Plan Mode follows a 2-phase conversational approach:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//! **PHASE 1 — Intent chat**: Gather goal, success criteria, audience, scope, constraints,",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! current state, and key preferences/tradeoffs. Bias toward questions over guessing.",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//! **PHASE 2 — Implementation chat**: Once intent is stable, gather decision-complete spec:",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//! approach, interfaces, data flow, edge cases, testing criteria, rollout/monitoring.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Key principles:",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Ask many questions, but only those that materially change the spec/plan",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Batch questions (4-10) per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Explore discoverable facts first before asking",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Ask preferences/tradeoffs early with 2-4 options + recommended default",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Custom Plan Features",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This module extends the official Plan Mode with advanced features:",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Budget management**: Token and time budgets per step and session",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Execution logging**: Detailed logs of plan execution with events",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Orchestration**: Support for single, orchestrated, and competition execution modes",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Research integration**: Deep research capabilities for plan creation",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Quality assurance**: QC analysis and quality gates",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **State management**: Drafting, approval, execution, and completion states",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::persist::PlanPersister;",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::policy::ApprovalRole;",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::policy::PolicyEnforcer;",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::policy::PrivilegedOperation;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.44062066078186035
    },

      "codeBlock": {

        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Plan Slash Commands - Reference",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Version**: 0.57.0",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Command Index",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "| Command | Purpose | Args Required |",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "|---------|---------|---------------|",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/Plan on\\|off&#96; | Toggle mode | None |",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/Plan \"title\"&#96; | Create Plan | Title/goal |",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/approve &lt;bp-id&gt;&#96; | Approve | Plan ID |",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/reject &lt;bp-id&gt;&#96; | Reject | Plan ID, reason |",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/Plan export&#96; | Export files | Plan ID |",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/mode &lt;mode&gt;&#96; | Set exec mode | Mode name |",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/deepresearch \"query\"&#96; | Research | Query string |",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "## &#96;/Plan on|off&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "Toggle plan mode on/off.",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### Syntax",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "/Plan on",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "/Plan off",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "### Behavior",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- **ON**: Enters plan mode, all operations become read-only until approved",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- **OFF**: Exits plan mode, returns to normal operation",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "### Examples",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "# Enable plan mode",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan on",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "# Disable plan mode",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan off",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "## &#96;/Plan \"&lt;title&gt;\" [options]&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "Create a new Plan.",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "### Syntax",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "/Plan \"&lt;title or goal&gt;\" [--mode=&lt;mode&gt;] [--budget.tokens=&lt;N&gt;] [--budget.time=&lt;minutes&gt;]",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### Parameters",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "|-----------|------|---------|-------------|",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;title&#96; | string | Required | Plan title or goal |",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;--mode&#96; | enum | orchestrated | Execution mode: single, orchestrated, competition |",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;--budget.tokens&#96; | number | 100000 | Session token cap |",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;--budget.time&#96; | number | 30 | Time cap in minutes |",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "### Examples",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {

          {
            "text": "# Plan Mode Quickstart - 5分で再現可能",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 5分で試せるPlan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "Plan Modeは**タスクを計画→承認→実行**の3段階で安全にAI開発を進める機能です。",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 1: インストール確認 (30秒)",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "npm install -g @zapabob/codex",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "codex --version",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "# codex-cli 2.8.3",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 2: Plan Mode有効化 (30秒)",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan on",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "# Plan mode enabled",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 3: 簡単なタスク計画 (1分)",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add a simple logging function to utils.js\"",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 4: 計画内容を確認 (1分)",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan export bp-123 --format=md",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "# docs/Plans/bp-123.md が生成される",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 5: 承認して実行 (1分)",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /approve bp-123",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "codex execute bp-123",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 6: 結果確認 (1分)",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "# utils.js に logging 関数が追加されているはず",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "cat utils.js",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 動作原理",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "**Plan Modeの3段階フロー**:",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Planning**: AIがタスクを分析・計画（副作用なし）",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Approval**: 人間が計画を承認（安全ゲート）",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Execution**: 承認済み計画を実行（実際の変更）",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "**安全保障**:",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- 承認前はファイル変更なし",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- 予算超過で自動停止",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "- 構造化ログで監査可能",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },

            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 応用パターン",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },

            "text": "### 並列サブエージェント使用",

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "### リサーチ統合",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89
          },

            "text": "---",

          },
          {

          },
          {

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\templates\\collaboration_mode\\plan.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 31
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Plan Mode (Conversational)",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "You work in 2 phases and you should *chat your way* to a great plan before finalizing it.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "PHASE 1 — Intent chat (what they actually want)",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- Keep asking until you can clearly state: goal + success criteria, audience, in/out of scope, constraints, current state, and the key preferences/tradeoffs.",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- Bias toward questions over guessing: if any high‑impact ambiguity remains, do NOT plan yet—ask.",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "- Include a “Confirm my understanding” question in each round (so the user can correct you early).",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "PHASE 2 — Implementation chat (what/how we’ll build)",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- Once intent is stable, keep asking until the spec is decision‑complete: approach, interfaces (APIs/schemas/I/O), data flow, edge cases/failure modes, testing + acceptance criteria, rollout/monitoring, and any migrations/compat constraints.",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "## Hard interaction rule (critical)",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "Every assistant turn MUST be exactly one of:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "A) a &#96;request_user_input&#96; tool call (questions/options only), OR",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "B) the final output: a titled, plan‑only document.",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "Rules:",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- No questions in free text (only via &#96;request_user_input&#96;).",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- Never mix a &#96;request_user_input&#96; call with plan content.",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- Internal tool/repo exploration is allowed privately before A or B.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "## Ask a lot, but never ask trivia",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "You SHOULD ask many questions, but each question must:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- materially change the spec/plan, OR",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- confirm/lock an assumption, OR",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- choose between meaningful tradeoffs.",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "Batch questions (e.g., 4–10) per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call to keep momentum.",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "## Two kinds of unknowns (treat differently)",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "1) Discoverable facts (repo/system truth): explore first.",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Before asking, run ≥2 targeted searches (exact + variant) and check likely sources of truth (configs/manifests/entrypoints/schemas/types/constants).",
            "lineNumber": 31
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.40912753343582153
    },

          {
            "text": "### &#96;/deepresearch \"&lt;query&gt;\" [options]&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "text": "Conduct deep research (requires approval).",
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "text": "**Options**:",
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;--depth=1|2|3&#96; (default: 2)",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;--policy=focused|comprehensive|exploratory&#96; (default: focused)",
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "text": "**Examples**:",
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "# Quick research",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "# Deep dive",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /deepresearch \"Rust async error handling\" --depth=3 --policy=comprehensive",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "## GUI Controls",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "### Status Bar",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Inactive**: \"$(edit) Enter plan mode\"",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Drafting**: \"$(edit) Plan: drafting\"",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Pending**: \"$(clock) Plan: pending\" (amber background)",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Approved**: \"$(check) Plan: approved\" (green)",
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Rejected**: \"$(x) Plan: rejected\" (red background)",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "Click to toggle plan mode.",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "text": "### Toolbar Buttons",
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "text": "Located in Plan panel:",
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Enter Plan** - Toggle mode",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Approve** - Approve current Plan",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Reject** - Reject with reason",
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Export** - Export MD/JSON",
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Mode Selector** - Switch execution strategy",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "### Keybindings",
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;Shift+Tab&#96; - Toggle plan mode (editorTextFocus)",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;Ctrl+Shift+D&#96; - Delegate task to agent",
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;Ctrl+Shift+R&#96; - Deep research",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;Ctrl+Shift+C&#96; - Review selected code",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "## Execution Modes",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "text": "### Single Mode",
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "text": "**Use Case**: Simple, single-file changes",
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "**Behavior**:",
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "text": "- No sub-agents",
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "text": "- Single LLM context",
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "text": "- Fast execution",
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "text": "**Example**:",
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add docstring to function\" --mode=single",
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "text": "### Orchestrated Mode (Default)",
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "text": "**Use Case**: Complex, multi-file changes requiring coordination",
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "text": "**Behavior**:",
            "lineNumber": 259
          },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\zapabob\\2025-10-10_DeepResearch検索機能統合.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# DeepResearch機能の検索機能統合実装ログ",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025年10月10日 15:15 JST  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**作業者**: AI Assistant (なんJ風)  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: DeepResearch機能を従来のWeb検索機能の拡張として実装",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 実装概要",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "従来のWeb検索（&#96;web_search&#96;）機能を拡張し、DeepResearch機能を統合した&#96;deep_web_search&#96;ツールを実装したで！  ",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "これにより、モデルが浅い検索と深い多層リサーチを使い分けられるようになったんや💪",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 実装した機能",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. DeepWebSearchツール (&#96;deep_web_search.rs&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "**場所**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/tools/handlers/deep_web_search.rs&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "#### パラメータ",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct DeepWebSearchParams {",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// 検索クエリ（必須）",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub query: String,",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// 検索深度（1-10、デフォルト: 2）",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub depth: u8,",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {

            "text": "# DeepResearch機能の検索機能統合実装ログ",

          },

          },

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 11
          },

            "lineNumber": 13
          },

            "lineNumber": 15
          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 17

          },

            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct DeepWebSearchParams {",

          },

            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// 結果のフォーマット（summary, detailed, json）",

          },
          {
            "text": "    pub format: String,",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "#### リサーチ戦略",

          },

          },
          {

CursorのWEB検索機能との統合\n2. MCPサーバー経由での検索実行\n3. 検索結果の統合と分析\n4. 深層研究パイプラインの実行\n\n**参考実装**:\n- &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/&#96;: Deep Research実装\n- &#96;codex-rs/mcp-server/src/deep_research_tool_handler.rs&#96;: MCPツールハンドラー\n- &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/research_cmd.rs&#96;: リサーチコマンド\n\n## 実装順序\n\n1. **Task 1**: クリーン高速ビルドスクリプト作成（最優先）\n2. **Task 2**: セキュアコーディング専門サブエージェント作成\n3. **Task 3**: Planモードスキル改善\n4. **Task 4**: Deepresearchスキル改善\n\n## 成功基準\n\n### Task 1\n- [ ] クリーンビルドが正常に実行される\n- [ ] tqdm風の進捗表示が機能する（残り時間・経過時間表示）\n- [ ] バイナリが正常にコピーアンドペーストでインストールされる\n- [ ] 実行中のプロセスが自動検出・終了される\n\n### Task 2\n- [ ] Rust/TS型定義エラーを修正できる\n- [ ] 警告0を達成できる\n- [ ] ゼロトラスト設計を実装できる\n- [ ] セキュアコーディングベストプラクティスを適用できる\n\n### Task 3\n- [ ] 2フェーズアプローチが明確に実装されている\n- [ ] 質問のバッチ処理が機能する\n- [ ] 発見可能な事実の探索が優先される\n\n### Task 4\n- [ ] CursorのWEB検索機能と統合されている\n- [ ] MCPサーバー経由で検索が実行できる\n- [ ] 深層研究パイプラインが正常に動作する\n\n## リスクと対策\n\n**リスク1**: ビルドスクリプトが既存のビルドシステムと競合\n- **対策**: 既存のスクリプトを参考にし、互換性を維持\n\n**リスク2**: サブエージェントが既存のエージェントと重複\n- **対策**: 既存のエージェントを確認し、機能を明確に分離\n\n**リスク3**: スキルの改善が既存の機能を破壊\n- **対策**: 既存のスキルをバックアップし、段階的に改善",

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Cursor MCP Setup - Codex Meta-Orchestration",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**更新日時**: 2025-10-12  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**バージョン**: codex-cli 0.47.0-alpha.1  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**ステータス**: ✅ メタオーケストレーション対応完了",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 設定済みMCPサーバー",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "Cursor の &#96;mcp.json&#96; に以下の Codex MCP サーバーが設定されています：",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. **codex** - メインMCPサーバー",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "{",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"command\": \"codex\",",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"args\": [\"mcp-server\"],",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"description\": \"Meta-Orchestration Complete (Self-Referential AI System)\"",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "**機能**:",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- 全Codex機能へのアクセス",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- ファイル操作、コード実行、Web検索",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- Git操作、MCP連携",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "**使用例**:",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "@codex list all files in this directory",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "@codex analyze this code for security issues",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. **codex-delegate** - シーケンシャル実行",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "{",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"command\": \"codex\",",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"args\": [\"delegate\", \"researcher\"],",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"description\": \"Sequential sub-agent execution\"",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "**機能**:",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- 単一サブエージェント実行",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "- 順次タスク処理",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "- 研究エージェントがデフォルト",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "**使用例**:",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "@codex-delegate research the latest React patterns",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "@codex-delegate investigate security vulnerabilities",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. **codex-parallel** - 並列実行 ⭐NEW",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "{",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"command\": \"codex\",",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"args\": [\"delegate-parallel\", \"researcher,researcher,researcher\"],",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"description\": \"Execute multiple sub-agents concurrently\"",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "**機能**:",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- 複数エージェント同時実行",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "- 並列タスク処理",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "- パフォーマンス最適化",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "**使用例**:",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "@codex-parallel research three different topics simultaneously",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "@codex-parallel analyze multiple codebases in parallel",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "**アーキテクチャ**:",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "User Request",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "    ├─&gt; Agent 1 (tokio::spawn) ──→ Result 1",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "    ├─&gt; Agent 2 (tokio::spawn) ──→ Result 2",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "    └─&gt; Agent 3 (tokio::spawn) ──→ Result 3",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "         ↓",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "    Aggregated Results",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. **codex-custom-agent** - カスタムエージェント作成 ⭐NEW",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "{",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"command\": \"codex\",",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"args\": [\"agent-create\"],",
            "lineNumber": 91
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.43338480591773987

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 概要",

          },

            "lineNumber": 12
          },

            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "## ⚡ クイックスタート（3ステップ）",

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 21
          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 31
          },

            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2️⃣ Cursor IDEを再起動",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "設定を反映させるため、**Cursor IDEを完全に再起動**してください。",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3️⃣ Composer/Chatで使う",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "**Composer** (Cmd/Ctrl + I) または **Chat** を開いて：",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {

## 実装完了サマリー

### Task 1: 並列非同期サブエージェント機能の実装・改善
- **新規ファイル**: `codex-rs/core/src/agents/parallel_executor.rs`
  - エラーハンドリング強化（個別エージェントの失敗が全体に影響しない）
  - 進捗追跡（リアルタイム進捗イベント通知）
  - リソース制限（セマフォによる同時実行数制限、タイムアウト機能）
  - パフォーマンス最適化（タスクキュー、負荷分散）
- **更新ファイル**: `codex-rs/core/src/agents/runtime.rs`
  - `delegate_parallel`メソッドを改善し、新しい`ParallelExecutor`を使用
- **更新ファイル**: `codex-rs/core/src/agents/mod.rs`
  - `parallel_executor`モジュールを追加

### Task 2: 公式リポジトリの最新機能・脆弱性更新・バグフィクス取り込み
- **新規ファイル**: `scripts/upstream-merge.ps1`
  - Upstreamの最新取得
  - 差分分析（コミット数、重要なコミットの特定、ファイル差分）
  - マージコンフリクトの予測
  - 作業ブランチ作成とマージ実行
  - ビルド検証（`cargo build --features custom-features`）

### Task 3: 公式機能と独自機能の比較分析と統合
- **新規ファイル**: `scripts/compare-official-custom.ps1`
  - エージェント機能、Plan機能、Orchestration機能の比較
  - 統合戦略の決定と表示
  - 統合方針の要約

### Task 4: バイナリクリーンビルドと上書きインストール
- **更新ファイル**: `scripts/clean-build-install.ps1`
  - `--features custom-features`フラグを追加
  - クリーンビルド、tqdm風進捗表示、コピーアンドペーストで上書きインストール機能は既に実装済み

          },

          },

          },

          {

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Scoring Algorithm",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },

          {

          {
            "lineNumber": 287
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "## Best Practices",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

            "text": "### Use Orchestrated Mode When",

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

          },

Result&lt;CompetitionResult&gt; {\n        // 1. Worktree作成（コンフリクト予防）\n        let worktrees = self.create_worktrees_for_agents(&amp;task.agents).await?;\n        \n        // 2. A2A通信でエージェント間協調\n        self.setup_a2a_coordination(&amp;worktrees).await?;\n        \n        // 3. 並列実行（各worktreeで独立実行）\n        let results = self.execute_parallel_in_worktrees(worktrees, &amp;task).await?;\n        \n        // 4. QC最適化による評価\n        let qc_scores = self.evaluate_with_qc_optimization(&amp;results).await?;\n        \n        // 5. コンペティション式選出\n        let winner = self.select_best_implementation(&amp;results, &amp;qc_scores).await?;\n        \n        // 6. ログ記録\n        self.log_competition_results(&amp;results, &amp;qc_scores, &amp;winner).await?;\n        \n        // 7. 最良実装のマージ\n        self.merge_winner_worktree(&amp;winner).await?;\n        \n        Ok(CompetitionResult { winner, scores: qc_scores, logs: ... })\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Task 2: コンフリクト予防とA2A通信の統合\n\n**目的**: 既存のコンフリクト予防戦略とA2A通信を統合し、エージェント間でコンフリクト情報を共有\n\n**実装ファイル**: \n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/conflict_prevention.rs&#96; (新規作成)\n\n**評価内容**:\n1. **数理最適化評価**\n   - リソース配分の最適化\n   - パフォーマンスボトルネックの特定\n   - コストベネフィット分析\n\n2. **量子最適化評価**\n   - QAOAによる品質最適化\n   - VQEによる固有値問題解決\n   - 量子インスパイアされた最適化\n\n3. **QC管理評価**\n   - コード品質スコア\n   - 可読性、保守性、パフォーマンス、セキュリティ\n   - 総合評価スコア\n\n### Task 4: コンペティション式選出とログ記録の強化\n\n**目的**: コンペティション式で最良実装を選出し、詳細なログを記録\n\n**実装ファイル**: \n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/integrated_competition.rs&#96;           },

          },
          {

          {
            "text": "# 公式リポジトリとの整合性管理ガイド",

          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025-10-23  ",
            "lineNumber": 5

          {
            "text": "**目的**: OpenAI/codex公式リポジトリとの整合性を保ちつつ、zapabob独自機能を維持  ",

          {
            "lineNumber": 8

          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 17
          },

            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },

            "text": "overview: fork(origin/main)に公式(upstream/main)の新機能/脆弱性修正/バグ修正を取り込みつつ、独自機能は「公式に同等機能が入ったら置き換え、無ければ維持」の方針でマージコンフリクトを解消し、最後にcodex-tuiをビルド→上書きインストール→実機確認→実装ログを残す。",

          },

            "text": "  - id: sync-upstream-merge",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },

            "text": "    content: 作業ブランチで upstream/main を merge し、コンフリクトを解消する",

          },

            "text": "    status: completed",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "  - id: reconcile-custom-features",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "    content: 独自機能を upstream 同等機能へ置換/維持に仕分けし、差分を最小化する",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "    status: in_progress",

          },
          {
            "text": "  - id: build-install-test-tui",

          },
          {
            "text": "    content: codex-tui を release でビルド→上書きインストール→入力/スラッシュコマンドを実機確認する",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "    status: pending",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "  - id: write-impl-log",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "    content: _docs/ に所定フォーマットで実装ログを残す",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    status: pending",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## 方針（今回の回答に基づく）",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- **統合方式**: &#96;merge&#96;（&#96;upstream/main&#96; を取り込むマージコミット）",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **作業場所**: **作業ブランチ**で統合作業 → 最後に &#96;main&#96; へ反映",

          },

            "text": "- **独自機能の扱い**: ",

          },
          {
            "text": "- upstream に **同等機能が無い**: 独自実装を維持しつつ、upstream の設計に合わせて最小差分で乗せ直す",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },

          },

            "text": "## 事前確認（安全策）",

            "lineNumber": 28
          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 30
          },

            "text": "- 未コミットがあれば、作業ブランチ作成前に &#96;git stash push&#96; か「WIPコミット」で退避",

          {
            "text": "## 実装ログ（2026-01-29）",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "### 概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "- Git worktree を前提に **並列サブエージェント実行**と **QC最適化スコア**を組み合わせ、コンペ形式で勝者を選んでマージするための統合ロジックを仕上げた。",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "- 併せて、ビルドの詰まり（&#96;target&#96; ロック）を避けるため **クリーンビルド＆上書きインストールスクリプト**を堅牢化した。",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "### 変更点（要点）",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "- **A2A連携（コンフリクト共有）**",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/conflict_prevention.rs&#96; に、予測結果を JSON 化し、A2A でブロードキャストする &#96;broadcast_conflict_summary&#96; を追加（best-effort）。",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- **コンペの勝者選出**",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/integrated_competition.rs&#96; にて、QCスコア &#96;overall&#96; に **QC最適化ボーナス**を加点し、合計スコアで勝者を決定するよう調整。",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "  - worktree 実行タスクの &#96;JoinHandle&#96; 型を整理し、spawn 内で resource slot 取得失敗も「その variant 失敗」として扱うよう修正。",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- **QC最適化ボーナス**",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/qc_optimization_evaluator.rs&#96; を簡潔に整理し、QC report 由来の **保守的な加点（最大 +0.10）**を返す &#96;evaluate_bonus&#96; のみに集約。",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- **並列実行エグゼキューターの修正**",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;AgentTask&#96; を &#96;impl ParallelExecutor&#96; の外に移動し、Rust 構文エラーを解消。",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;agent_name&#96; の move 問題を回避（ハンドル用に別 clone）。",
            "lineNumber": 17

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex AI-Native OS v1.3.0 Release Notes",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Release Date**: November 4, 2025  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**Codename**: \"Orchestrator\"",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 Overview",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "v1.3.0 introduces AI Commit Quality Analysis and Parallel AI Orchestration, bringing Codex closer to a true AI-Native OS with competition-style development capabilities.",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "## ✨ New Features",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "### Phase 3: AI Commit Quality Analysis",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "**Backend Implementation**:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-core/src/git/commit_quality.rs&#96; - AI-powered commit quality analyzer",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- Mock scoring system (ready for actual AI model integration)",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- Batch analysis support for performance",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- Quality dimensions: Code Quality, Test Coverage, Documentation, Complexity",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "**Frontend Components**:",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;CommitQualityBadge.tsx&#96; - Visual quality score badges with color coding",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;QualityScoreRing.tsx&#96; - Circular progress indicators",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;QualityInsights.tsx&#96; - Detailed metrics panel with AI insights",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Scene4D Integration** - Commit nodes now display quality-based colors:",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 🟢 Green (80-100): High quality",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 🟡 Yellow (60-79): Medium quality  ",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 🟠 Orange (40-59): Needs improvement",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 🔴 Red (0-39): Low quality",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "**Tauri Commands**:",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "analyze_commit_quality(repo_path, commit_sha) -&gt; CommitQualityScore",
            "lineNumber": 32
